disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in scrap metal dealing or bulk merchandise container dealing without registering
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Whoever violates division (B)(1) of section 4737.04 of the Revised Code is guilty of a felony of the fifth degree.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Purchasing or receiving a special purchase article or bulk merchandise container in violation of statutory requirements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Whoever violates division (B)(2) of section 4737.04 of the Revised Code is guilty of a felony of the fifth degree for the first offense and a felony of the third degree for any subsequent offense.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to maintain required records or comply with recordkeeping requirements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Whoever fails to comply with or violates section 4737.01, 4737.012, or 4737.041, division (C), (D), (E), (F), (G), or (I) of section 4737.04 … is guilty of a misdemeanor of the first degree.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Purchasing or receiving articles from persons identified on the law enforcement list of known thieves or receivers of stolen property
disciplinary_grounds.quote: No scrap metal dealer or bulk merchandise container dealer shall purchase or receive articles from any person who is either identified on the list the dealer receives from the law enforcement agency

disciplinary_grounds.description: Purchasing or receiving special purchase articles or bulk merchandise containers from a person under eighteen years of age
disciplinary_grounds.quote: No scrap metal dealer or bulk merchandise container dealer shall purchase or receive any special purchase articles or bulk merchandise containers from any person who is under eighteen years of age.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to take a photograph of each person who sells or gives an article to the dealer
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Every scrap metal dealer shall take a photograph, in accordance with rules adopted by the director, of each person who sells or otherwise gives the dealer an article for which the dealer must make record under division (C) of this section.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Purchasing or receiving metal articles from a person who refuses to show personal identification card or allow photograph
disciplinary_grounds.quote: No scrap metal dealer shall purchase or receive any metal articles … from a person who refuses to show the dealer the person's personal identification card, or who refuses to allow the dealer to take a photograph

disciplinary_grounds.description: Purchasing or receiving more than one catalytic converter per day from the same person (except from a licensed motor vehicle dealer)
disciplinary_grounds.quote: No scrap metal dealer shall purchase or receive more than one catalytic converter per day from the same person except from a motor vehicle dealer as defined in section 4517.01 of the Revised Code.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Purchasing or receiving a marked beer keg except from an authorized manufacturer or agent
disciplinary_grounds.quote: No scrap metal dealer shall purchase or receive a beer keg that is marked with a company name or logo except from a manufacturer of beer as described in section 4303.02 of the Revised Code or an agent authorized by the manufacturer to dispose of damaged kegs.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Court may suspend registration for 90 days for second or subsequent violation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: For any second or subsequent violation … a court may suspend the registration issued to the scrap metal dealer or bulk merchandise container dealer under section 4737.045 of the Revised Code for a period of ninety days

disciplinary_grounds.description: License revocation for violation of junk yard statutes by licensee or officers/agents/employees
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any license or renewal thereof issued under this section may be revoked by the chief executive officer of the municipality or the county auditor … for any violation of sections 4737.01 to 4737.12 of the Revised Code, by the licensee or by any of his officers, agents, or employees.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Operating or maintaining a junk yard adjacent to interstate or primary systems without a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: No person shall operate or maintain a junk yard, adjacent to the interstate or primary systems inside a municipality, except in zoned or unzoned industrial areas, unless he has first obtained a license issued under sections 4737.05 to 4737.12

establishment_regulation_required.quote: Before a license is granted or renewed under sections 4737.05 to 4737.12 of the Revised Code, the sheriff of each county … shall inspect the junk yard within the sheriff's, police officer's, constable's, or chief's respective jurisdiction to determine if it complies with sections 4737.05 to 4737.12 of the Revised Code.
